passages.quote:
This draft revised code of practice provides guidance to employers and workers on the fair and transparent allocation and distribution of tips, gratuities and service charges.

It is expected to come into force in January 2027. For now, employers should continue to follow the existing code of practice.

The existing code of practice was first published after the passage of the Employment (Allocation of Tips) Act 2023, which makes it mandatory for all tips to be passed on to workers without deductions.

It has been revised following the passage of the Employment Rights Act 2025, which makes it mandatory for employers to consult with workers at their place of business when developing or revising their written tipping policies.

A public consultation was held on this draft revised code of practice.
